name: Hospitals
source:
Ever wanted to play as a cute mad scientist who is absolutely sure she's not completely crazy along with her assistant? Well now you can! Featuring Dr. Viocina as the deranged Doctor, her amnesiac assistant Desia, and the Detective hell-bent on finding the truth Farron, this short game is centered around the happenings at a small "hospital" located in the forest after several cases of missing peoples have come in to the police department.

[From [url=https://mikomigames.itch.io/hospitals] itch.io[/url]]
